sourceText:
Baja Burgers
By: KC Quaretti-Lee
Published: Friday, September 3, 2010 - 6:14am

Ingredients




1 ripe avocado sliced
1 pound lean ground beef
1 pound or ground turkey
6 chopped fresh sage leaves for the turkey burgers
1 teaspoon salt& ½ t. pepper
1/4 cup finely chopped sweet onion
Ranch Dressing or Ketchup (Ranch for the lettuce
sliced dill pickles
2 large loaf country French bread cut into wide wedges, or smaller ones)

Preparation

1 Mix together ground beef, salt, pepper and onion (or mix turkey, sage, onion, salt & pepper) 2 Form into oblong patties to fit bread wedges 3 Grill patties as desired 4 Slice through center of bread wedges and put lettuce on bottom half 5 Place patty on top of lettuce, top with pickles, dressing and avocado slices 6 Serve and enjoy

About


One thing nice about doing burgers this way is that you can make them any size you want.  My son Giuliano get a HUGE beef Baja burger, while Marina and I choose small turkey Baja burgers.  Yes I do make both turkey and beef Baja Burgers at the same time.  I just use less of each ground meat and have found it really doesn't take much more time to mix two batches and EVERYONE is happy!
